citation: Porter, Simon (2021). Shape Model of Hydra. figshare. Version 1. CC BY 4.0.
coordinateSystem: Released model XYZ retained without rotation, recentering or invented topography. Spherical map longitude = atan2(y,x), north latitude = asin(z/r).
orientationQualification: Source download omits the fitted pole/prime-meridian solution. Pole/spin and epoch presentation are approximate; model longitude zero is a display convention, not a controlled IAU cartographic meridian.

material.qualification: All source texels are unavailable; constant raster is entirely marked no-data before the shared gray-grid preparation.

coverage: New Horizons saw predominantly the northern hemisphere. Southern model radii and the short axis are poorly constrained; geometric interpolation does not create observed terrain.
